definitions.gloss: the middle; middle part (of a place)
definitions.explanation: The middle part of a space or line, such as a train car, a street or a slope. Common in announcements: {中|なか}ほどまでお{進|すす}みください (please move to the middle of the car).

definitions.gloss: halfway through; the middle (of a period or event)
definitions.explanation: A point around the middle of a period of time or a sequence, as in {月|つき}の{中|なか}ほど (the middle of the month) or {話|はなし}の{中|なか}ほど (midway through the story).

examples.japanese: {中|なか}ほど⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧お⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please move along to the middle of the car.
There's a shop about halfway up the slope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{混|こ}んでいた→混む：02574_komu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{車内|しゃない}→車内：06203_shanai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中|なか}ほど⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: It was crowded, so I stood and waited in the middle of the car.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中|なか}ほど⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}ります→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: I'll be back around the middle of next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中|なか}ほど⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧。
examples.english: It started raining midway through the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中|なか}ほど⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: It was decided to put a short break about halfway through the lecture.

notes:
Softer and less exact than ⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧: it means somewhere around the middle, not the exact center.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {中|なか}ほど⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧お⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please move to the middle (train and bus announcement)
- ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中|なか}ほど: partway along the line
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中|なか}ほど: the middle of the month

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧: the exact center
- ⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧: halfway; in the middle (of a period), more written
